notes.title: UPDATE: Performance improvements, invert option, and more!
notes.notes:
[u][b]We just pushed a well needed update with huge performance improvements and new features![/b][/u]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29244093/1fd02b35729bf9b5aefa7b3a0f34f3c09db83d60.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Invert Y-axis option. It can be toggled on/off from the in-game pause menu.

[*]Dynamic narration audio. Narration volume should now adjust based on music and location. Previously, the music would drown out the narration; this is now fixed.[/list]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Drastic performance improvements.

[*]Optimized texture streaming for less texture pop-in.

[*]Fixed windowed mode not correctly displaying game name.

[*]Fixed an out of bounds glitch in chapter 3.

[*]Improved culling of foliage and level streaming for better performance. 

[*]Reduced file size to 5gb. Nearly half of what it was![/list]

[h1]Known Issues:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Unfortunately, you may still experience some slight texture pop-in if you are running at 4k resolution. This is something we are looking into. It is caused by lack of v-ram, so if your card has less than 4gb of v-ram, we recommend you don't run at 4k to avoid this issue.

[*]LOD pop-in is still being improved. In the next update, this should be completely fixed.[/list]


Let us know if you come across anymore issues! Also, we have a [h1]BIG ANNOUNCEMENT[/h1] about the game coming later this week. Have fun!
